findings.body: The new `reasoning_effort: String` field is added to a config struct without a default. If this struct deserializes from a config file (as the surrounding `budget_usd_per_pr`, `max_tokens`, etc. strongly imply), every existing configuration file that omits `reasoning_effort` will now fail to load with a "missing field" error. Config additions should be `Option<String>` with a default, or annotated with `#[serde(default)]`, so existing deployments keep working. I could not confirm the serde derivation or the config loader from this diff alone, but the struct's shape makes breakage on deserialize the likely consequence.
findings.title: Make reasoning_effort optional or default to avoid breaking existing configs

lookups.why: Check the struct's derives (Deserialize/Serialize) and whether serde defaults are used on sibling fields, to know if a new non-optional field breaks existing config files.
Find every place reasoning_effort is constructed or read, to see whether a missing default causes a compile break or a runtime config-load failure.
